description: Held-out everyday questions for subject tags, written before the subject vocabulary existed and never to be used for tuning. Written by the same developer as the rules, so this is not independent; real or third-party questions should replace it when available. 'about' tests subject only, never legal accuracy. A case that prompts a rule change stops being held out and moves to subject-fit.json.
